summary: On January 7, 2025, Medusind, Inc. filed a notice of data breach with the Attorney General of Maine after discovering that hackers were able to access the company’s computer network. In this notice, Medusind explains that the incident resulted in an unauthorized party being able to access patients’ sensitive information, which includes their names, health insurance and billing information, financial information, medical information, Social Security numbers, driver’s license numbers, passport numbers, dates of birth, email addresses, postal addresses, and phone numbers. Upon completing its investigation, Medusind began sending out data breach notification letters to all individuals whose information was affected by the recent data security incident. The Medusind data breach was only recently announced, and more information is expected in the near future.
